
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/DeepSleep0629/p/22804247" title="发布于 2026-09-02 10:58">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">题解：P10027 梦境世界</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/P10027" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">题目</a>。</p>
<p>考虑 DP。由于撤销操作会导致环路，所以不能直接 DP。</p>
<p>我们发现对于撤销操作肯定会回到某一个点，也就是存在一个点，走了若干步再撤回再走。这样就好转移了。</p>
<p>定义 <span class="math inline">\(G_{i,j,k}\)</span> 代表从 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 出发，拥有 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 瓶撤销药，到达终点的方案数。</p>
<p>同时，我们定义 <span class="math inline">\(F_{i,j,k}\)</span> 为从 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 出发，消耗 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 个药，最后返回 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 的种类数。</p>
<p>注意，这里的 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 代表循环变量，题目中的 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 以 <span class="math inline">\(K\)</span> 表示。</p>
<p>可以发现转移公式就是 <span class="math inline">\(\forall x\in[0,k]\)</span>，也就是当前节点走出去再回来消耗的药的个数，将 <span class="math inline">\(F_{i,j,x}\times(G_{i+1,j,k-x}+G_{i,j+1,k-x})\)</span> 求和就是 <span class="math inline">\(G_{i,j,k}\)</span>。即：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[G_{i,j,k}=\sum_{x=0}^kF_{i,j,x}\times(G_{i+1,j,k-x}+G_{i,j+1,k-x})
\]</div><p></p><p>答案就是：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sum_{k=1}^KG_{1,1,k}
\]</div><p></p><p>现在考虑计算 <span class="math inline">\(F_{i,j,k}\)</span>。很显然，<span class="math inline">\(F_{i,j,k}\)</span> 就是往下或往右走 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 格再走 <span class="math inline">\(k-x-1\)</span> 步之后退回来，然后再在原地走 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 步。转移式：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[F_{i,j,k}=\sum_{x=0}^{k-1}F_{i,j,x}\times(F_{i+1,j,k-x-1}+F_{i,j+1,k-x-1})
\]</div><p></p><p>转移的注意事项：</p>
<ul>
<li>转移 <span class="math inline">\(G_{i,j,k}\)</span> 时 <span class="math inline">\(i,j\)</span> 要逆序。</li>
<li>最外层是 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<p>时间复杂度：<span class="math inline">\(\Theta(nmk^2)\)</span>，空间复杂度：<span class="math inline">\(\Theta(nmk)\)</span>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
#define For(i, l, r) for(int i = l, i##QWQ = r; i &lt;= i##QWQ; i++)
#define Rev(i, l, r) for(int i = l, i##QWQ = r; i &gt;= i##QWQ; i--)
using namespace std;
const int N = 105;
int F[N][N][N], G[N][N][N], mp[N][N];
int main() {
    cin.tie(0)-&gt;sync_with_stdio(0);
    int n, m, K, p, s, ans = 0; cin &gt;&gt; n &gt;&gt; m &gt;&gt; K &gt;&gt; p &gt;&gt; s;
    for(int x, y; s-- &amp;&amp; cin &gt;&gt; x &gt;&gt; y;) mp[x][y] = 1;
    For(i, 1, n) For(j, 1, m) if(!mp[i][j]) F[i][j][0] = 1;
    For(k, 1, K) For(i, 1, n) For(j, 1, m) if(!mp[i][j]) For(x, 0, k - 1)
        F[i][j][k] = (F[i][j][k] + 1ll * F[i][j][x] * (F[i + 1][j][k - x - 1] + F[i][j + 1][k - x - 1]) % p) % p;
    G[n][m][0] = 1;
    For(k, 0, K) Rev(i, n, 1) Rev(j, m, 1) if(!mp[i][j]) For(x, 0, k)//i,j逆序
        G[i][j][k] = (G[i][j][k] + 1ll * F[i][j][x] * (G[i + 1][j][k - x] + G[i][j + 1][k - x]) % p) % p;
    For(k, 0, K) ans = (ans + G[1][1][k]) % p;
    cout &lt;&lt; ans &lt;&lt; "\n";
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>


</div>
